# Copilot Instructions — mangatek_flutter

## Language

All code, comments, and strings must be in **English**.

---

## Git

| Command | Allowed |
|---------|---------|
| `git add` | ✅ |
| `git commit` (any form) | ❌ |
| `git push` (any form) | ❌ |

---

## Generated files — never edit manually

| Pattern | Regenerated by |
|---------|---------------|
| `lib/generated/assets.gen.dart`, `fonts.gen.dart` | `dart run build_runner build` |
| `lib/generated/i18n/` | `flutter gen-l10n` |
| `**/*.g.dart` | `dart run build_runner build` |

After modifying annotated classes, run: `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`

---
